name: Bridon American Corporation
old_description: Bexco® Synthetic Ropes by Bekaert is a leading European manufacturer of precision-engineered synthetic mooring, towing and lifting ropes for offshore, marine and industrial applications.
about:
Bridon American Corporation operates from Exeter, Pennsylvania, as the U.S. arm of Bekaert's rope division. Bekaert, a global leader in steel wire transformation and coating technologies, traces its rope-making heritage back more than 300 years, while the modern corporation builds on over 140 years of innovation in materials and manufacturing. The business brings together centuries of rope-making expertise with Bekaert's strengths in technology and innovation to serve mission-critical applications worldwide.

The company manufactures precision-engineered steel wire ropes and synthetic ropes under the Bridon® and Bexco® brands. Its product portfolio covers mooring, towing, lifting, and hauling ropes for heavy-duty use. Beyond manufacturing, Bridon American provides Ropes360® services, including installation of reels up to 450 metric tons with on-site splicing and socketing, visual and advanced non-destructive inspections, forensic laboratory testing of new and retired ropes, repair and maintenance such as re-lubrication and re-socketing, training, and custom design with tailored logistics and consignment stocking.

Customers span renewable energy, oil and gas, mining, cranes and industrial, and commercial fishing. In renewable energy, the ropes are used on wind turbine installation vessels. Oil and gas clients rely on them for offshore drilling, marine riser tensioners, and offshore lifting. Mining operations use shovel ropes, dragline ropes, and drum winder ropes. Crane applications include offshore cranes, telescopic mobile cranes, and industrial hoist ropes. Commercial fishing fleets employ trawl warps and purse wires.

Bekaert positions its rope business around four legacy strengths: heritage in mission-critical rope manufacturing, technology leadership and innovation, deep understanding of market needs, and global presence with local expertise. The company emphasizes a "better together" approach, co-creating solutions with customers to extend rope life, maximize safety, and reduce downtime through integrated inspection, testing, and maintenance services.

The company functions as a wholesale packaging supplier, offering a broad catalog of glass, plastic, metal, and paper containers. Its product range includes vials, bottles, jars, tubes, bags, wraps, labels, and closures for pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, cosmetic, and specialty markets. Brigade Packaging does not manufacture these items but sources and distributes them in bulk, targeting small and medium-sized businesses with volume pricing.

name: Bright Home Energy
old_description: Premium solar and battery storage, designed for Arizona homes — and the way you actually live in them. Engineered, installed and serviced by Bright Home Energy.
about:
Bright Home Energy operates from Phoenix, Arizona. The company has been installing solar and battery systems for eight years and has powered more than 6,000 homes across the Phoenix metro area, including Mesa. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs, installs, and services residential solar photovoltaic and battery storage systems, working with Tesla Powerwall, SolarEdge, and Enphase equipment. In-house engineering models each system to the individual roof before installation. Beyond solar, Bright Home Energy provides home-performance upgrades including Aeroseal duct sealing — which reduces post-seal leakage to 10% or less — and R-49 blown-in attic insulation with air sealing. The firm handles permitting, utility interconnection, and ongoing production monitoring, backing its work with a 25-year workmanship warranty.

Bright Home Energy serves homeowners in the Phoenix metropolitan area, with a focus on the desert climate that delivers roughly 300 days of sun per year. Typical residential projects range from $18,000 to $34,000 before the 30% federal tax credit. The company also coordinates roof replacement through its sister firm, Bright Home Construction, allowing a single scaffolding setup for both trades.

Bright Home Energy positions itself as an engineering-first installer that is certified on three major storage platforms without sales quotas, enabling unbiased recommendations. Its desert-specific design approach accounts for extreme heat and high solar irradiance, and the company guarantees system performance with real-time monitoring and a promise to return to the roof if production falls short.

name: Broadway Brake Corp/Fleetway Heavy Duty Parts
old_description: Best Prices and Best Service of Heavy Duty Truck and Trailer Parts Servicing Local Massachusetts and the Surrounding New England Areas.
about:
Broadway Brake Corp/Fleetway Heavy Duty Parts operates from Somerville, Massachusetts, on Broadway at 45 Broadway. The business traces its roots to 1937 when Broadway Brake opened its doors. In January 2020, Broadway Brake merged with Fleetway Heavy Duty Parts, combining truck parts and service with trailer parts and service into a single operation.

The company distributes heavy-duty truck, trailer, and transit parts, acting as an authorized dealer for brands such as Aurora, Wabash, Stoughton, Fruehauf, Transcraft, Lufkin, and Benson, as well as Morgan and Supreme truck body OEM parts. It also stocks product lines from Trucklite, Meritor, Haldex, Pro-par, Firestone, Stemco, Timken, Eaton, Dayton, Dayco, Velvac, Wix, SKF, and others. Beyond distribution, the shop provides make-to-order hydraulic hose assemblies and brake shoe relining, and offers delivery service to local customers.

Customers range from owner-operators with a single truck to large fleets across Massachusetts and the surrounding New England region; the company also ships nationwide. Its focus is on keeping trucks, trailers, and transit vehicles on the road, serving the transportation, trucking, trailer, and public transit sectors.

The company emphasizes its mission to provide a customer-friendly parts and service department that goes the extra mile, backed by over 80 years of experience in the Greater Boston area. The 2020 merger was intended to unify truck and trailer expertise under one roof, giving fleets a single source for both product lines.

old_description: with Qualifying Purchase of a New Briggs and Stratton Home Standby Generator
about:
Brook Field Service operates from Northfield, Vermont, and has served Northern New York and New England for nearly 40 years as a generator sales and service provider.

The company provides generator installation, maintenance, and repair for all brands, along with standby power system design, transfer switch and battery backup installation, complete system engineering, load bank testing, and preventative maintenance agreements. It also offers generator rentals, financing, onsite evaluations, electrical service upgrades, and FLO EV charger installation. Technicians are factory-trained and TQP-certified for generator and transfer switch repairs, and the firm maintains Northern New England's largest generator fleet to support 24/7 emergency service. All installations receive engineering supervisory coverage and job-site load testing before handover.

Customers range from residential homeowners to commercial and institutional clients, including hospitals, nursing homes, banks, construction equipment firms, Vermont state agencies requiring emergency generator inspections, and small businesses. Service territory covers Vermont, Maine, New Hampshire, New York, and Massachusetts.

Brook Field Service distinguishes itself as the only Vermont company that troubleshoots and repairs generators, engines, and transfer switches with every employee cross-trained in all three disciplines, so a single service call covers the full system. Its operating philosophy emphasizes integrity, superior service over automation (no robot voices or answering machines), honest communication, and treating employees as revenue sources rather than expenses.

about:
Brooklyn WoodWorking operates from Brooklyn, New York, where it has provided custom millwork and solid-surface fabrication for over a decade. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but its website notes more than ten years of experience and over 260 completed projects.

The shop designs, fabricates, and installs custom cabinetry, furniture, and architectural millwork for both residential and commercial clients. Its capabilities span framed and frameless cabinetry, reception desks, teller lines, nurse's stations, hospital and dental casework, library end panels, and canopy tops. It also produces solid-surface countertops using brands such as Corian®, Avonite®, HI-MACS®, and others, partnering with Corian New York and Solid Surface New York for material supply and installation. The company states it uses state-of-the-art technology and custom-designed equipment in its manufacturing processes.

Residential customers include homeowners, remodelers, and home builders. Commercial work covers professional offices, retail spaces, multi-family dwellings, healthcare facilities, and libraries, often in collaboration with architectural firms. The firm emphasizes scheduling flexibility and on-time delivery as part of its customer-care approach.

Brooklyn WoodWorking's stated mission is to provide quality products, professional client services, and a constructive work environment. Its vision centers on honest work, timeless quality, and genuine care, with teamwork cited as a key differentiator.
